compute_iou: compute the Intersection over Union between two binary masks using torch tensors
compute_accuracy: compute the pixel-wise accuracy between two binary segmentation masks
compute_precision_recall: compute precision and recall values for a predicted mask against a ground truth mask
compute_f_score: compute the F-score from precision and recall values with a configurable beta squared parameter
run_metrics: run IoU, accuracy, and F-max metrics on saliency prediction arrays against ground truth masks
